subject: CAIQ alignment and evidence onboarding — FinStripe procurement
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@finstripe.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, marcus_lin@redwood.inference
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: CAIQ alignment and evidence onboarding — FinStripe procurement

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the intro call today. As discussed, FinStripe is evaluating Redwood Private for a regulated payments workload and the procurement team has asked for a CSA/CAIQ mapping and supporting evidence. To keep the scope tight, we're proposing the initial package cover: production VPC + ingress/egress, key management for tokenization, audit logging (90 days), and subprocessors list.

I've attached our CAIQ template (redwood_caiq_template_v1.xlsx) — it's pre-populated with our canonical control mappings (CCM IDs), short answers, and a column for artifact names. Could you confirm the expected CAIQ version (v4 vs v5) and whether you need evidence for every control or only the subset mapped to your trust requirements? Also confirm whether FinStripe requires evidence to be delivered to a shared S3 bucket or via a secure Drive link.

Proposed timeline: we can assemble the control artifacts within 7 business days once scope is confirmed. If you need an expedited turnaround, we can prioritize cryptography and audit logging artifacts first.

Deliverables we plan to provide:
- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet with redwood control mapping
- Network segmentation diagram + VPC config snapshot
- Key rotation policy & KMS configuration export
- Audit log retention and sample logs (sanitized)

If that aligns, I'll assign owners internally and follow up with a drive folder and HubSpot deal update.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_caiq_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, CAIQ mapping template)

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@finstripe.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@finstripe.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 22:04:18 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ alignment and evidence onboarding — FinStripe procurement

Hi Aditya,

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the template. A couple of clarifying items from procurement/security: 

1) CAIQ version: We're working off CSA CAIQ v4 for this RFP.
2) Scope: we need evidence for all controls that map as "in-scope" for our payments PCI-adjacent environment — effectively any control touching data flow or cryptography. Non-applicable controls should be marked with rationale.
3) Delivery: we prefer evidence uploaded to a pre-provisioned secure drive (we'll provide a service account) + a manifest spreadsheet listing file names and control IDs.
4) Subprocessors: provide a current subprocessors table and dates of last attestation for each.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood's Private deployment will use customer-managed KMS in our VPC or Redwood-managed keys? That will affect which artifacts we can provide.

Target window: procurement is asking for initial package by Apr 12. Can you meet that?

I've attached a short list of questionnaire clarifications for our security team to help you prioritize.

Best,
Emma Collins
Head of Security Operations
FinStripe

Attachment: FinStripe_csa_questions.pdf (questions and requested artifact manifest)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, marcus_lin@redwood.inference
Cc: Emma Collins <emma.collins@finstripe.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:18:45 +0000
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ alignment and evidence onboarding — FinStripe procurement

Laura / Marcus — forwarding Emma's note from FinStripe. Procurement wants CAIQ v4 coverage for payments scope, evidence uploaded to a secure drive, and a manifest. Target delivery Apr 12 (9 business days).

Quick proposed split: 
- Marcus: own cryptography/key artifacts and KMS configuration exports (confirm whether customer-managed KMS is an option; if not, provide Redwood-managed key rotation policy + screenshots of KMS console). Deliverables: KMS config export, key rotation policy doc, sample rotation logs (sanitized).
- Laura: own networking and logging artifacts — network segmentation diagram, VPC config snapshot, firewall rule export, and sample audit logs (SANITIZED).
- Aditya (me): compile CAIQ spreadsheet, populate answers and map artifacts to CAIQ control IDs; upload manifest + drive folder; own comms with FinStripe.

Please prioritize marking any control that will be "attested but no artifact" with a short rationale and an owner (e.g., "policy only, no artifact: SOC2 controls covered by policy X").

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Fh7/FinStripe-CAIQ-evidence (I'll create and share when artifacts are ready). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/RSW-3421 (update the deal stage to "Procurement: CAIQ" after upload).

Emma, copying you so the owners are visible. Marcus and Laura — can you confirm owners and earliest delivery dates by EOD Monday Apr 5?

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
